title: Amulet of Will
summary:
The Amulet of Will is a powerful artifact once used by Lord Casterwill and alluded to in the journal of Eathon Lambert. It has become the symbol of the Casterwill family, decorating their artifacts and landmarks. 

Legend states that anyone attempting to summon either of the three Legendary Titans, Araknos, Behemoth, or Tao, without bearing the Amulet of Will, will be afflicted by a deadly curse. 

The four gemstones on the Amulet of Will represent these Legendary Titans: blue for Tao, green for Behemoth, red for Araknos, as well as a white one for Overlos, the Legendary Titan of Immortality sealed inside the Amulet of Will itself.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
The Amulet of Will was forged in ancient history by Lord Casterwill in order to summon the Titans from the Spirit World and bring them to Earth to help humanity fight against the Nullifiers. It was the original amulet, used to summon every Titan from the Spirit World. Due to the Legendary Titan of Immortality, Overlos, being sealed within the Amulet, Lord Casterwill was able to live for the 500 years that the war lasted.

Some time after the war, Lord Casterwill cursed the Rings of the Legendary Titans Araknos, Behemoth and Tao, to prevent anyone from bonding with them if they didn't possess the Amulet of Will. After Casterwill died, the story of the Amulet of Will became blurry and ambiguous, and travelled through time as a mystery.

In the 1950s, a trio of friends from the Huntik Foundation went on dangerous adventures, looking for the Legendary Titans. While they were close to finding Araknos, they learnt about the existence of the ancient curse, but a greedy Simon Judeau did not listen and triggered the curse.

In 1958, after spending a whole year bedridden, Simon vanished and in 1959, decided to create The Organization to help him find the Amulet of Will. [The Secret of Two Generations] 

Some time later, Simon learnt that his former friend Eathon Lambert was close to finding the resting place of the Amulet of Will and hunted him down. Eathon prefered to fake his death rather than lead this corrupted man to the amulet, and vanished inside the Spirit World. [Doorway to Huntik] 

Eathon only left behind a detailed journal with clues leading to the Amulet of Will. His son, Lok Lambert, stumbled on the journal by chance which would start his and the Huntik Foundation team's journey to find both his lost father and the Amulet of Will. [A Seeker is Born]

After a long journey following through the journal's clues, the team finally obtained the Amulet after passing four tests in Atlantis, placing Lok Lambert with Bravery, Dante Vale with Prowess, Sophie Casterwill with Intelligence, and Zhalia Moon with Nobility. [Coming of Age]

Inside the King Solomon's mines, Lok was able to bond with Tao without triggering the Casterwill curse by bearing the Amulet of Will around his neck. [To Be Together] 

On their way to hide the Amulet of Will in one of the Foundation's hideout, the Huntik team was attacked by Wind and Shauna, who successfully stole the Amulet from them and gave it to the Professor. [The Secret of Two Generations]

After the team made their way inside the Professor's castle, the Professor told them that he found a ritual to summon the Legendary Titan of Immortality, Overlos, contained in the Amulet of Will, and used the pretense of healing Metz to convince Dante to give him Behemoth and Tao. [The Divine Comedy] The Professor then performed the ritual by summoning the three Legendary Titans of Mind, Body, and Spirit but thanks to the intervention of Lok, who combined the powers of Dendras and Archwarder, Overlos came under the Foundation's control and Lok ordered him to seal the Legendary Titans and their Rings back in the Spirit World. [The Mission]

Later, the team saw the motif of the Amulet of Will decorating the ground inside the volcano of an Indonesian island, with four lava pits in place of the four gemstones. The ring of the Legendary Titan of Rebirth, Phoenix, was hidden in the lava pit where the red gemstone would have been on the real amulet, giving a hint to the Huntik team and allowing them to retrieve the Titan. [The Phoenix's Ashes]
